verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's own mobile docs say you can send a photo into a chat through the iPhone share sheet, so image input exists. Nothing in the pack documents or corroborates how well the Bot understands image content. missing for 10: documented image/screenshot understanding, evidence of interpretation accuracy, desktop screenshot sharing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can share screenshots and photos and have the assistant accurately interpret what is in them

citations.quote: On iPhone, use the system share sheet and choose Grok Bot to send a photo, file, link, or text into a chat.
